----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lucide Icons — ISC License
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

This directory's purpose is to ship the upstream Lucide licence and
attribution alongside the bundled lucide.ttf file that
cmake/FetchEmojiFont.cmake downloads at configure time and that
examples/helloworld/main.cpp registers at runtime via
Window::register_emoji_font_memory() as the canonical "icon" face for
Private Use Area (U+E000..U+E650) codepoints.

Lucide is licensed ISC.  Anyone shipping a binary that embeds the
lucide.ttf bytes must:
  1. preserve this licence file;
  2. preserve the upstream attribution for Lucide and its contributors;
  3. (no ShareAlike — ISC permits unrestricted re-distribution).

A stand-alone binary that links the unmodified upstream font satisfies
(1)+(2) trivially because the font is an unmodified upstream artifact.
A Fluffy distribution that bundles the font inherits the upstream's
ISC terms on the FONT ITSELF only — unrelated Fluffy source code is
NOT bound to ISC by this attribution file.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Upstream attribution
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lucide — https://lucide.dev
Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
Distribution artifact: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide-static/font/lucide.ttf

The bundled file is the consolidated "lucide-static" font (single TTF
containing every icon as a `glyf` outline glyph) shipped under the
lucide-static npm package at https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static.
Each icon is mapped to a Private Use Area codepoint in the range
U+E000..U+E650 (see https://lucide.dev/guide for the icon-name →
codepoint table for the current release).

Pin version: 0.473.0 — see FLUFFY_EMOJI_FONT_VERSION in
cmake/FetchEmojiFont.cmake.
